signals.name: Sales conversion decline
signals.description: Sales conversion is down 25.8% against the comparison period.

signals.name: Receivables deterioration
signals.description: Overdue receivables increased 50.0% against the comparison period.

signals.name: Software spend anomaly
signals.description: Software spend is 35.5% above the comparison period.

signals.name: Inventory shortage
signals.description: Projected stock cover is projected to last only 12 days.

evidence.description: HubSpot conversion fell from 31% to 23% in the current three-month period.
Outlook median first response time grew from 3 hours to 17 hours for high-intent leads.
Proposal-preparation meetings increased 42%, consuming selling time.
Proposal templates, pricing sheets, and case studies are fragmented across 187 files in Drive and OneDrive.
Only 42% of high-intent leads received a second touch within five business days.
QuickBooks shows $48,000 in overdue invoice balance, up from $32,000.
Average invoice payment time increased from 39 to 54 days.
Gmail shows reminder coverage on only 42% of overdue accounts, with no consistent owner sequence.
Seven overdue accounts have either a blank or stale CRM owner.
Outlook contains recurring supplier PO attachments that are re-keyed into the spreadsheet queue.
The Excel purchasing tracker records the same order, vendor, and shipment fields manually.
Calendar blocks labeled data entry and reconciliation grew to 18 hours per month.
Slack has 28 shipment-status threads asking for information already present in email attachments.
Recurring software charges rose while three overlapping products have low activity.
Slack activity and team records show three tools with seat utilization below 35%.
The 42-person team has overlapping CRM, inbox, and proposal utilities with unclear ownership.
Shopify order volume for Beta Industrial Gloves rose 26% while replenishment cadence stayed flat.
Shopify inventory projects only 12 days of cover for Beta Industrial Gloves.
QuickBooks revenue for the affected SKU is down 18% in the latest month because orders are being delayed.
Slack contains nine recent stock-shortage discussions from sales and warehouse staff.

issues.title: Sales conversion decline
issues.description: Conversion fell from 31% to 23% while proposal preparation and response time expanded.

issues.title: Receivables are aging
issues.description: Overdue balances and payment delay are rising while reminder coverage is inconsistent.

issues.title: Admin work is fragmented
issues.description: Purchase orders and shipment questions move manually across email, spreadsheets, calendars, and Slack.

issues.title: Software cost leakage
issues.description: Recurring software spend is rising while several overlapping tools show low activity.

issues.title: Inventory stockout risk
issues.description: Demand is rising for selected products while stock cover is falling and teams are already reporting shortages.

rootCauses.title: Proposal workflow is too slow
rootCauses.explanation: The sales team is spending more time assembling proposal context while response time is rising.

rootCauses.title: Proposal knowledge is fragmented
rootCauses.explanation: Past proposals, pricing, and case studies are distributed across 187 files rather than a searchable approved library.

rootCauses.title: Follow-up ownership is inconsistent
rootCauses.explanation: The lower second-touch rate is consistent with a workflow gap, but individual rep intent is not directly observable.

rootCauses.title: Overdue follow-up is not consistently triggered
rootCauses.explanation: Accounting data confirms the balance and payment delay; email activity suggests reminders are inconsistent.

rootCauses.title: Account ownership data is stale
rootCauses.explanation: Seven overdue accounts lack a reliable owner, so the accountable recipient for a reminder is unknown.

rootCauses.title: Purchase orders are transferred by hand
rootCauses.explanation: Supplier email attachments are manually copied into the Excel purchasing tracker and then rechecked in Slack.

rootCauses.title: Shipment status is fragmented across channels
rootCauses.explanation: The team uses Slack to chase status that is not linked to the original supplier document.

rootCauses.title: Overlapping tools are under-used
rootCauses.explanation: Recurring charges continue for tools with low activity and overlapping responsibilities.

rootCauses.title: Replenishment cadence misses demand changes
rootCauses.explanation: Shopify demand is increasing for a selected SKU while inventory and accounting signals show exposure.

rootCauses.title: Stockout risk is discussed before it is measured
rootCauses.explanation: Slack contains the warnings, but there is no shared alert tied to projected days of cover.

opportunities.title: Automate proposal generation
opportunities.summary: Create a searchable proposal workflow that gathers approved pricing, context, and examples before a seller reviews the draft.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Deploy Proposal Intelligence in draft-only mode and measure proposal time for 30 days.

opportunities.title: Automate receivables follow-up
opportunities.summary: Route overdue account reminders to the right owner using QuickBooks aging and communication history.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Prepare reminder drafts for owner approval; never send automatically.

opportunities.title: Improve lead-response workflow
opportunities.summary: Give high-intent leads a consistent first and second touch while proposal work is underway.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Configure an approval-based lead response queue for high-intent opportunities.

opportunities.title: Consolidate overlapping SaaS tools
opportunities.summary: Review low-utilization CRM, proposal, inbox, and analytics subscriptions before renewal.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Create a renewal review with seat utilization and overlapping capabilities attached.

opportunities.title: Repair account ownership hygiene
opportunities.summary: Resolve blank and stale CRM ownership so receivables and follow-up tasks have an accountable owner.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Run an owner exception report and route changes for approval.

opportunities.title: Automate PO and order data entry
opportunities.summary: Extract supplier PO fields once, match them to the vendor, and route exceptions to operations.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Deploy Document Automation for attachment extraction with exception review.

opportunities.title: Improve inventory forecasting
opportunities.summary: Combine Shopify demand, QuickBooks sales, and current stock cover into an early replenishment signal.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Set a 21-day cover alert with a weekly owner review.

opportunities.title: Create searchable company knowledge
opportunities.summary: Index approved proposal, pricing, and case-study documents with source links and freshness dates.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Build an approved document index with permission-aware retrieval.

opportunities.title: Automate shipment-status communication
opportunities.summary: Turn supplier and warehouse status into a shared update before the same question appears in Slack.
opportunities.recommendedAction: Draft internal and customer-facing shipment updates from approved source documents.
